summary: Capture executable RED evidence for the combined #71/#83 durable persistence defects on the protocol-v5 main.
steps: Ran the tests-only candidate through GitHub Actions run 34019230528.
Read the Ubuntu full-suite log and confirmed all existing checkpoint/protocol/M10 tests stayed green while exactly the four new durable-integrity assertions failed.

Froze the production format as one committed `*.checkpoint.json` envelope (bounded JSON header line + raw checkpoint bytes), retaining legacy pair read compatibility while eliminating sidecar publication for new writes.

evidence.note: Expected RED: corrupt and schema-incompatible durable state both produced Missing expected rejection; under umask(0) checkpoint mode was 0666 instead of 0600; a pre-planted predictable temp symlink redirected the raw checkpoint payload outside durableRoot. Existing suite otherwise passed.

limitations: Aggregate 64 MiB durable quota remains #89 and will be implemented on the new format after #71/#83 merge.
This record is RED-only evidence and does not claim the production fix is complete.
